anti_analysis: anti_vm_cpuid_hypervisor_bit: anti_vm_check executes CPUID leaf 1 and tests ECX bit 31 (hypervisor-present flag); returns 1 if running under a hypervisor
sleep_delay_evasion: if a VM/hypervisor is detected the process calls Sleep(30000) and exits silently without injecting; also Sleep(1000) after injection
dynamic_api_resolution: NtCreateThreadEx is resolved at runtime via GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress instead of a static import (used as fallback when CreateRemoteThread fails)
encrypted_payload: shellcode and a 16-byte block are stored encrypted in .data and only decrypted in memory at runtime

encryption_details.algorithm: Two schemes: (1) repeating-key XOR for the 48-byte shellcode (buf[i] ^= key[i % 12]); (2) custom toy block cipher named aes128_decrypt_block — NOT real AES: 10 rounds over a 16-byte block using the standard AES S-box: state[j] = sbox[state[j]] ^ key[j] ^ (27*round), round=0..9
encryption_details.key: XOR key (12 bytes): c3 7a 9f 2e 55 8b 1d 6c e4 31 a8 4f ; S-box cipher key (16 bytes): ASCII "4xdm1n_S3cr3t!!!"
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys hardcoded in .rdata: g_xor_key @ 0x140004000, g_aes_sbox (standard AES S-box) @ 0x140004020, g_aes_key @ 0x140004120. Encrypted data in .data: g_encrypted_shellcode (48 bytes) @ 0x140003000, g_encrypted_block (16 bytes) @ 0x140003030

file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13 (not stripped, contains DWARF debug info; original source windows_level16_CodeCave.c)

injection_details.method: Code cave injection: find_code_cave parses the target image's PE headers, scans executable sections (Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE 0x20000000) for either section slack (VirtualSize - SizeOfRawData >= payload size, cave at VirtualAddress+SizeOfRawData) or a contiguous run of 0xCC/0x00 padding bytes. Then VirtualProtectEx(cave, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) -> WriteProcessMemory(payload) -> VirtualProtectEx(cave, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ) -> CreateRemoteThread(start=cave). Fallback: dynamically resolves NtCreateThreadEx from ntdll.dll and calls it with THREAD_ALL_ACCESS (0x1fffff). Waits via WaitForSingleObject(thread, 5000) and CloseHandle.
injection_details.other: Payload is a 48-byte shellcode stored XOR-encrypted in .data (g_encrypted_shellcode) and decrypted at runtime with a 12-byte repeating XOR key. CreateRemoteThread imported statically; NtCreateThreadEx resolved manually.
injection_details.target_discovery: GetCurrentProcess() returns pseudo-handle to self; GetModuleHandleA(NULL) obtains the process's own image base, whose PE sections are then scanned for a code cave
injection_details.target_process: Itself (self-injection into the process's own loaded image)

techniques: pe_header_parsing (MZ/PE/section walk to find code caves)
anti_vm_cpuid (CPUID leaf 1 ECX bit 31 hypervisor check)
sleep_delay_evasion (Sleep 30000 on VM detect, Sleep 1000 post-injection)
